summary_en: Abalance will purchase 2.0 million shares (up to 488 million yen) via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 17 September 2026 at 244 yen per share, as part of a larger 4.0 million share acquisition programme authorized in July 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Block Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On 16 September 2026, Abalance Corporation announced a block purchase of treasury stock through ToSTNeT-3, a Tokyo Stock Exchange off-hours trading system. The company will purchase up to 2.0 million shares at 244 yen per share (total consideration up to 488 million yen) on 17 September 2026 at 8:45 a.m., with results to be announced immediately after the trading window closes.

This purchase forms part of a larger share acquisition program authorized by the board of directors on 23 July 2026. The parent program permits the acquisition of up to 4.0 million shares (approximately 21.02% of outstanding shares) for up to 2.0 billion yen over the period from 1 June 2026 to 31 December 2026, to be executed through on-market purchases. The company notes that market conditions may prevent execution of part or all of the planned purchase; the number of shares will not be adjusted regardless of market outcomes.
